#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    vector<int> cuts;
    int parity[2] = {0, 0};

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i != 0 && parity[0] == parity[1]) {
            cuts.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]));
        }
        parity[arr[i] & 1]++;
    }

    sort(cuts.begin(), cuts.end());

    int count = 0;
    int remaining = b;
    for (int cost : cuts) {
        if (cost <= remaining) {
            count++;
            remaining -= cost;
        }
    }

    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
